role: dormant zero-credit nested historical-value market and exact finite-coder shadow

predecessor_identity.requirement: A must reproduce the predecessor's latest exact-route donor, generic edit candidate probabilities, Q63 parent mixture probabilities, and post-truth update order exactly.

content_types.numeric: complete donor matches signed ASCII integer; current prefix matches the same grammar
content_types.delimited: at least two frozen ASCII delimiters are already present
content_types.token: at least two ASCII alphanumeric runs or decoded whitespace are already present
content_types.atomic: fallback donor class; current prefix becomes atomic only after eight decoded bytes

typed_kernel_assignment.C_control: SplitMix64 rotates each typed assignment to the first valid different kernel; generic leaves remain unchanged

arm_interfaces.P: eight immutable Endpoint428 Q16 probabilities per truth byte
arm_interfaces.K: P to coder while every PALIMPSEST state transition executes
arm_interfaces.M: up to eight exact-route generic-edit leaves
arm_interfaces.H: M plus deduplicated route-shape and decoded-prefix content-type generic leaves
arm_interfaces.T: H plus one typed leaf per donor
arm_interfaces.X: T geometry over wrong-route donors matched by power-of-two completion-age and length buckets
arm_interfaces.C: T donors with every typed assignment changed to a different valid kernel
arm_interfaces.G: T geometry over physical donors matched by exact age, content type, and length bucket

finite_coder.bit_order: MSB first within each truth byte
finite_coder.termination: one pending-bit flush followed by zero padding to a complete byte
finite_coder.frame: eight-byte PMKTAR2-NUL magic, little-endian uint64 truth-bit count, then coder payload
finite_coder.independence: P/K/A/M/H/T/X/C/G own independent intervals and termination
finite_coder.decoder_replay: Every shadow archive must decode its exact truth schedule under the same immutable probability stream before comparison

callback_order: Apply every declared prior-byte and deferred value commit available at the current coordinate.
Apply structural exit and entry callbacks in the frozen route-tape order.
At field entry, snapshot eligible semantic and matched-control donors using only completed history.
Before each truth bit, compute parent, leaf, hierarchical-market, and Q63 mixture probabilities from the decoded prefix.
Send the frozen arm probability to its independent finite coder, then update hierarchical and outer weights with truth.
After the complete truth byte, update every donor kernel and the causal content-type prefix.
Install the current value only after field exit and the exact expected number of delayed commits.
activation_barrier: No corpus adapter, corpus replay, output receipt, native source, or native candidate is authorized until the exact HORIZON terminal route and every static activation requirement are satisfied.
